post_topic: Dead integration still live in production — what a stale comment revealed
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A left-to-right flow diagram titled 'The Silent Break' in bold navy text at the top.

On the far left: a rounded rectangle box labeled 'Checkout / Onboarding UI' with a small cursor/click icon. An arrow labeled 'User selects CRM integration' points right from this box.

In the center: a rounded rectangle box labeled 'Integration Layer' with a small plug icon. Below this box, a small sticky-note shape contains the text '// stale comment' in amber #F5A623.

From the Integration Layer box, an arrow points right toward the far-right element: a rounded rectangle box labeled 'CRM Vendor Endpoint' with a large red X overlaid on it and the word 'DISCONTINUED' in amber #F5A623 below it. The arrow connecting Integration Layer to this box is drawn as a dashed red line labeled 'Dead endpoint — no error thrown'.

Below the main flow, a horizontal bar in light gray spans the width of the diagram. Inside it, three small icon+label pairs read: 'No deprecation hook', 'No uptime alert', 'No UI guard'. Each label is in navy text. Each icon is a small amber warning triangle.

No return arrow. No success path shown. The dead end is the point.

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text 'Kelvin Davis' bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
